Berapa lama proses pembuatan website?: How long does it take to build a website?
Website company profile umumnya selesai: A company profile website typically takes 2–4 weeks depending on complexity. Landing pages take 1–2 weeks, while web applications take 4–8 weeks. Every project has a clear timeline from the start, and we always send regular progress reports.
Berapa biaya pembuatan website?: How much does a website cost?
Biaya tergantung kebutuhan: landing page: Pricing depends on your needs: landing pages start from Rp4.5 million, company profiles from Rp9 million, while e-commerce and web applications are quoted based on features. For an accurate quote, send a brief via the Start a Project page — we reply within 24 working hours.
Apa saja yang termasuk dalam paket?: What is included in the package?
Semua paket mencakup desain UI, pengemba: All packages include UI design, responsive (mobile-friendly) development, speed optimization, basic SEO (meta tags, sitemap, robots.txt), contact forms, WhatsApp integration, and a short content management training session. Advanced packages add blog/CMS pages, multi-language, and payment integration.
Alurnya sederhana: (1) konsultasi & brie: It is simple: (1) consultation & brief, (2) proposal & contract, (3) design & revisions, (4) development & integration, (5) cross-device testing, (6) launch, then (7) after-sales support. You get staging server access to see progress before go-live.
Paket standar menyediakan 2 putaran revi: Standard packages include 2 rounds of design revisions and 2 rounds of content revisions. Additional revisions are available at a fair cost, or you can choose a package with unlimited revisions during the project.
Kami membangun dengan stack modern: Lara: We build with a modern stack: Laravel (PHP) for the backend and CMS, PostgreSQL for the database, and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript or Vue.js for the interface. The result: clean, secure code that is easy to extend later.
Apakah website bisa dirawat setelah sele: Can the website be maintained after launch?
Bisa. Kami menyediakan paket pemeliharaa: Yes. We offer monthly maintenance packages: regular backups, security updates, uptime monitoring, and a content change allowance. This is optional — without it the website keeps running, but you do not get priority support.
Pembayaran dilakukan bertahap: 50% di mu: Payments are made in stages: 50% upfront to start the project and 50% when the website is ready to launch. We accept bank transfers and always issue official invoices. Payment terms are stated transparently in the contract.
Apakah saya bisa mengelola konten sendir: Can I manage the content myself?
Ya. Setiap website dilengkapi panel admi: Yes. Every website comes with a simple admin panel to edit text, images, services, portfolio, and blog articles — no coding skills required. We include a short training session and usage documentation.
Pendaftaran/pengalihan domain dan pengat: We can fully assist with domain registration/transfer and hosting setup. Domain and hosting costs are covered by you, but we handle the process end-to-end and make sure the SSL certificate is installed.
